## Research themes

<div class="theme-grid">
  <div class="theme-card"><h3>High-order optimization</h3><p>High-order Moreau and forward-backward envelopes, proximal-point algorithms, and nonquadratic regularization.</p></div>
  <div class="theme-card"><h3>Nonsmooth & nonconvex optimization</h3><p>Convergence theory, inexact methods, weak smoothness, prox-regularity, KL geometry, and generalized subdifferentials.</p></div>
  <div class="theme-card"><h3>Optimization for ML</h3><p>Robust learning, recommender systems, Bayesian sampling, inverse problems, and structured optimization.</p></div>
  <div class="theme-card"><h3>Algorithms & software</h3><p>Reproducible implementations, numerical validation, and practical optimization workflows.</p></div>
</div>
